title: Law requiring yearly reports on veteran preference in Mitchell-Lama housing
summary: This bill would require the Department of Housing Preservation and Development to submit an annual report on veteran preference in city-run Mitchell-Lama developments. The report must detail the number of veterans or surviving spouses who applied and were selected for occupancy, the documentation used to verify veteran status, and the safeguards in place to confirm eligibility. Reports would be due by September 1 of each year to the mayor, the Council speaker and the public advocate.
